title: Proof & Realness: Time Bank & Trust Graph

story.text:
# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [A] "we literally get data from the accounting systems and the time bank straight off from the activities we do" once the tools exist; asserted but not shown within the transcript.
- [A] "general productivity metrics" and "more participation and engagement."
- [A] OGM response: "do the ogm community do they get excited by that, do we get people turning up wanting to build on what we're building."
- [A] "press and media" asking "what is a trust graph," leading to "a lot more requests for demos."
- [D] the Berlin group: "they put just the star on a screen" in an "art room" where "people can just walk to the laptop and change the parameters" - "that's happening right now actually," though only at small scale.
- [T] hitchhikers / "first persons signing up."

**Headline metric.** The tetrahedron / trust graph changing live from real data input.
See [[Time Bank & Trust Graph]]  ·  hub: [[Proof & Realness?]]
